audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows disagree with their own why-text and with the packet chart: Level 2 reads Ambessa while whys[1] calls it a genuine coin-flip, Levels 4-5 reads Skill while whys[3] says she out-trades you, and Two+ items reads Ambessa while whys[6] says you win the duel.
audit.why: The chart and the paragraph under it gave opposite answers on three of seven rows.
audit.corrected: Level 2 reads Skill, Levels 4-5 reads Ambessa, Two+ items reads Sylas, matching the prose and the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike says stealing her R gives 'her engage tool' with no numbers on either ultimate.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s and Hijack is 80/55/30s — you get her defining tool back faster than she does, which is the entire reason the level-6 window exists.
audit.corrected: The 130s versus 80/55/30s comparison is stated in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and the late text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (a) The entry never names a single Ambessa ability — 'Dash Chain' is used throughout and is not in her kit; her abilities are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E) and Public Execution (R). (b) Her W is repeatedly described as missing-health burst that 'executes' you. Riot's text gives Repudiation a shield and a brace, and increases the slam's damage only if she blocked non-minion damage while bracing — there is no missing-health scaling and no execute.
audit.why: An invented ability name is unusable at the loading screen, and the W description inverts the correct play: poking a braced Repudiation is what empowers her slam, so the advice to chip her down was actively feeding her damage.
audit.corrected: All references renamed to the real abilities; Repudiation restated as shield-plus-brace where damage into the brace empowers the slam; Lacerate's 9-13s cooldown given as the fight window.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown appears anywhere; the do's say only 'fight when the chain is spent'.
audit.why: Public Execution 130/115/100s, Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14s and Lacerate 13/12/11/10/9s are the three clocks that decide when to step up.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5], mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Drakehound's Step is never mentioned — the dash she gets by queueing an attack or move command during a cast, which also empowers her next attack.
audit.why: It is why she appears to dodge your Q slow and reposition out of your hook angle; a player who does not know it reads her mobility as unpredictable.
audit.corrected: Named in dosFull[0].d and the mid text as the dash woven into every cast.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 5 belong to Ambessa. Her W damage scales hard with your missing HP, and her dash chain lets her dodge your Q slow and reposition around your E hook, turning her counter-trade into a kill threat if you over-commit. Respect her all-in range, keep W heal to respond to a burst pattern not to initiate one, and only fight when she has burned at least one dash on a minion wave. Level 6 flips the read: stealing her R hands you her engage, and she sits exposed without her defining tool — this is your all-in window, use it immediately before she reclaims tempo.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 5 belong to Ambessa. Repudiation shields her and slams back harder for every point of damage you put into the brace, and Drakehound's Step weaves a dash into each cast, so she slips your Q slow and repositions around your E hook. Respect her all-in range, keep the W heal to answer her burst rather than to open one, and step up only while Lacerate sits on its 9-13s cooldown. Level 6 flips the read: stealing Public Execution hands you a 130s suppress she must then fight without — that is your all-in window, use it before she reclaims tempo.

edits.before: At first item Ambessa's W burst peaks and your hook is her invitation to delete you if you are below half HP — play around your W cooldown and never give her a free hook angle when you are low. At two-plus items Sylas's AP and Riftmaker sustain start to pay off: Ambessa does not hyper-scale into an untouchable late game, and you can win the side-lane duel if you open with a stolen R. The matchup stays close throughout; your edge is Hijack turning her best tool against her, her edge is punishing every missed hook with a chain CC burst before your W can undo the damage.
edits.after: At first item Repudiation's slam peaks and your hook is her invitation to delete you below half HP — play around your 9s W cooldown and never poke her brace while you are low. At two-plus items Sylas's AP and Riftmaker sustain start to pay off: Ambessa does not hyper-scale into an untouchable late game, and you can win the side-lane duel if you open with a stolen R. The matchup stays close; your edge is Hijack recycling her 130s ultimate on an 80/55/30s clock, hers is punishing every missed hook before your W undoes it.

notes: 'Dash Chain' is not an Ambessa ability and appeared in eleven places; her real kit is Drakehound's Step / Cunning Sweep-Sundering Slam / Repudiation / Lacerate / Public Execution. The W description was worse than a naming error — it told the player to chip her down, when Riot's text says damage blocked during her brace INCREASES her slam. Repudiation and Public Execution both carry a 'grounding' derived flag that Riot's descriptions do not support, so no grounding claim was written; if grounding is real it would matter for Sylas's W and E and should be verified. Remaining 'Dash Chain' instances live in breakdown.wave / report[4] / report[3] / report[11] / dontsFull, which repeat boilerplate shared across the champion — flagged rather than rewritten piecemeal.
